notes:
Context: mid-market product analytics SaaS (Lucid Raft) building semantic search for product docs + in-app help. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API now; intend to move to Dedicated for predictable throughput if numbers look good. Short, choppy CRM-style notes below.

Discovery + business priorities:
- Head of Product (Maya Rao) wants embedded semantic search in product help center + cross-document recall for support teams. Key metric: reduce support handle time by 18-25%.
- Use profile: product docs + release notes + support transcripts (~1.1M docs initially, grows with daily ingest).
- Heavy batch embedding jobs: nightly ETL that re-embeds ~200k updated docs; daytime realtime ingest ~2-5k docs/day.
- Cost sensitivity: tight unit economics; wants to understand per-embedding cost at scale and TCO for Dedicated.

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Target search latency: 80-150ms end-to-end for top-5 results in UI; 95th percentile SLA target 200ms.
- Query throughput: peak 250-400 QPS during business hours; average 80 QPS off-peak.
- Embedding throughput for batch: need to sustain ~10k embeddings/min during nightly window; want ability to burst.
- Vector DBs in play: currently prototyping with pgvector (self-hosted), evaluated Pinecone early, also testing RedisVector. Wants Redwood to integrate smoothly with Snowflake / S3-based batch pipelines and ability to deliver vectors in formats compatible with pgvector/Pinecone.
- Model preferences: prefer open models for cost control but want Redwood-verified L2 quality; interested in options for model pinning and automatic fallback to a cheaper variant under load.
- Data: some docs are PII-adjacent (user emails, IDs) — require redaction in pipeline, encryption at rest, and KMS integration. Residency preference: us-east for now.

POC plan (on-site/remote):
- POC scope: 2-week proof: ingest 200k doc sample, run nightly re-embed pipeline, run search workload simulator (mix of 70% short queries, 30% long-form queries).
- Success metrics: 1) per-embedding cost <= target threshold (TBD in pricing call), 2) search latency p50 < 90ms, p95 < 200ms, 3) vector export/import to pgvector with no encoding/format issues, 4) seamless integration with S3/Snowflake for batch jobs.
- Milestones: kickoff meeting (2026-03-02), initial ingest + baseline run (2026-03-04), throughput tuning (2026-03-07), pricing + Dedicated sizing session (2026-03-15).

Quotes / voice notes from calls:
- CTO (Evan Kim): "We need predictable slot pricing for nightly embedding windows — variable costs kill our margins."
- Engineering lead (Rita Singh): "If we can do bulk embedding jobs with steady throughput and export to pgvector without heavy conversion, we can decommission our homegrown GPU batch runners."

Integration / ops questions they raised:
- How Redwood handles KV cache warmup for long-context reranking flows.
- Support for batch retry / partial-failure semantics for embedding jobs (idempotency keys).
- How cost is reported: per-token + per-embedding granularity, broken down by job and route in Console. Need granular cost attribution to product lines.
- Model rollout: want canary + automatic fallback to smaller model family during Dedicated capacity saturation.

Security & compliance:
- Needs SOC2 evidence and documentation; Redwood security FAQ linked in drive.
- SSO via SAML required for admin console in Production; audit logs required for access to vectors and keys.
- KMS integration mandatory for Dedicated/Private.

Commercial / pricing convo so far:
- Interested in a committed Dedicated tier if unit costs for embeddings + token generation are 25-40% below current public-cloud baseline.
- Asking for a blended estimate: overnight batch windows + daytime low-latency query tier.
- Requesting a 12-month glide path with guaranteed throughput floors and burst credits.

- SE (Diego) to run embedding throughput test on Hosted API (multi-threaded ingestion) and share perf logs.
- Schedule Dedicated sizing + pricing call (week of 2026-03-15).
